buys.item: Lunch at a dhaba: dal, rice, roti

answer.says: Sunil, I require sustenance. The dhaba's dal and rice will do. I have been walking too far on an empty stomach, and the body insists on its rights before the spirit can contemplate.
answer.thought: The hunger is a concrete negation that demands immediate satisfaction. I will eat the dhal and rice, for the body must be preserved to carry the spirit, and the system of wants is not to be spurned when it offers a direct solution to a physical deficit.
